newsitem.title: FINLAND: BIG DEAL IN LANSIVOIMA ON HELSINKI BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: BIG DEAL IN LANSIVOIMA ON HELSINKI BOURSE.

text.p: A big block of shares in Finnish electricity grid operator Lansivoima Oy was traded in-house on the Helsinki bourse on Wednesday afternoon, but the brokerage behind the deal declined any comment on the trade.
Merita Securities, the brokerage arm of banking group Merita Oy moved 618,599 Lansivoima shares at 220.00 markka each, up 5.00 markka or 2.33 percent on Tuesday's close.
"We have no comment," a senior Merita Securities broker said by telephone.
At 1525/1325 GMTR, Lansivoima traded at 220.00 markka, up five. Volume was 857,669 shares and trade in Lansivoima accounted for more than one fifth of total bourse turnover.
